exposure: Known midwife during labour and birth
outcome: Uninterrupted holding for at least 60 min
cohort: 1200 women who gave birth to a term baby within the previous three years in Australia
finding: Only 22% of participants experienced immediate, uninterrupted skin-to-skin contact and breastfeeding after birth ('pronurturance').
mod_finding: Pronurturance was less likely following caesarean section (adjusted Odds Ratio (aOR) 0.07, 95% Confidence Interval (CI) 0.03-0.17).
